parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return when paging is used. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page when paging is used. Default value: **10**, which indicates that 10 entries are returned on each page.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description:
The query conditions. The value is a JSON string.

> The query results vary based on the query conditions. For more information, see **Query parameter description**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of resource tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified.
